subject: Approved: seg23-c makes the count-test change now (legacy pinned on legacy rows; pack totals computed from data/content/*); seg23-core reviews it. live_check --seed uses the same computed totals
body: The counts must be computed from the bundle on disk, never hard-coded for packs. The sample-pack test filters by its own pack id. Keep at least one strict assertion per table, so a silent drop of rows still fails (expected = legacy + sum(packs)). Land it as a standalone commit before your renal batch, so other authors can rebase onto it. Other authors: don't edit those tests; rebase after it lands.
